label: Ceph RGW object-storage connector
summary: Prepare tenant-scoped Ceph object-gateway destinations for reviewed application objects and remote backup transfers.
core_boundary: This proposal targets an admitted RGW profile, not unrestricted Ceph cluster administration, raw RADOS access, disks or host commands. Local storage and recovery remain free Core. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Qualify a selected gateway/API profile with explicit tenant, account, bucket, prefix and credential ownership; do not infer complete behavior from an S3-compatible label.
Verify multipart integrity, versioning, encryption-key recovery and any retention/object-lock capability individually against the selected deployment.
Exercise interrupted transfer, quota exhaustion and retained-backup restore; bucket/object deletion and data purge require separate authorization and cannot follow connector removal automatically.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
